subject: AWS co-sell onboarding: ACE registration + PDM/PSM intro for Apollo Energy
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@apolloenergy.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@apolloenergy.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS co-sell kickoff: ACE registration + PDM/PSM intro for Redwood

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and cost controls you showed. We have an internal initiative to standardize LLM inference in our grid analytics group and would like to explore an AWS co-sell path so we can get procurement and our AWS TAM involved.

High-level:
- Use-case: realtime anomaly detection on SCADA streams + embedding-based search across maintenance logs
- Expected first-phase footprint: 2k concurrent requests, avg seq len 512, pilot for 3 months
- Budget range: procurement prefers to see a marketplace listing and co-sell commitment to expedite approvals

Can you put us through ACE registration and introduce the PDM/PSM folks on your side? I've attached a short deck with our scope and timelines (Apollo_Deck_Q2_v1.pdf). Procurement is looped in for commercial questions.

Proposed next steps from our side:
1) ACE intake/registration kickoff this week
2) Intro call with Redwood PDM/PSM to align on submission checklist and co-sell playbook
3) Shared timeline for marketplace listing and procurement milestones

Available windows for a 30-min sync: Wed 5/12 10-12 PT, Thu 5/13 14-16 PT.

Appreciate the help — Alex

Alex Johnson
VP Product, Apollo Energy
alex.johnson@apolloenergy.com
+1 415-555-0198
From: diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@apolloenergy.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell kickoff: ACE registration + PDM/PSM intro for Redwood

Alex —

Great to hear the demo landed well. Happy to drive the ACE intake and get our PDM/PSM looped in. I'm free Wed 5/12 10:30 PT — sending a calendar invite now for a 30-min alignment.

Quick notes before the call:
- I've attached our ACE checklist (AWS_ACE_registration_form.xlsx) — please fill the company legal name and estimated ARR fields before the call if you can.
- I'll introduce Hannah (PDM) and Ben (PSM) on the next thread so we have the right owners for the listing and co-sell motion.
- For the pilot sizing, our Dedicated team will validate concurrency and model choices during intake; having the seq length and traffic profile is perfect.

Forwarding your deck to our GTM to prep the co-sell ask. See you on Wed.

Thanks,
Diego
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@apolloenergy.com>, diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 15:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell kickoff: ACE registration + PDM/PSM intro for Redwood

Hi Alex, Diego —

Thanks for the context — Monica here from Customer Success; I’ll be supporting procurement readiness and pilots. Looping in Hannah (PDM) and Ben (PSM) as Diego mentioned.

Hannah: quick summary of Apollo's ask below so you have the intake details for ACE submission.
- Use-case: anomaly detection + embeddings search
- Pilot: 3 months, 2k concurrent, avg seq 512
- Priority: marketplace listing + co-sell to speed procurement

Ben, Hannah — can one of you volunteer to be the primary point for the ACE intake form? If helpful, I can collect the missing procurement fields and coordinate signatures.

Alex — our typical timeline once ACE intake is complete: 1) ACE registration submitted (2-4 business days review), 2) PDM-led readiness call to confirm listing assets, 3) Marketplace listing + co-sell enablement (2-3 weeks depending on AWS intake queues). We can try to compress this if Apollo needs a faster window.

Attachment: Apollo_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW stub)

Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@apolloenergy.com>
To: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com, diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@apolloenergy.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell kickoff: ACE registration + PDM/PSM intro for Redwood

Monica, team —

Thanks — appreciate the clear timeline. A couple of asks from procurement and our cloud team:
- Is there a standard AWS listing window you see once ACE is approved? (Procurement would like an expected date range.)
- Does Redwood have a co-sell asset package we can preview (datasheet, pricing tiers, one-pager on security/compliance)?

Procurement contact: procurement@apolloenergy.com — they’ll lead the commercial review. We’re targeting a contract signature by June 18th if possible.

Proposed timeline from Apollo:
- 5/12: Intake + intake form submitted
- 5/18: PDM readiness call (confirm listing assets)
- 6/01: Marketplace preview / draft listing for review
- 6/18: Target signature (internal approvals dependent)

I’ll join the intake call later today.

—Alex
From: diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@apolloenergy.com>, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell kickoff: ACE registration + PDM/PSM intro for Redwood

Alex — thanks for the timeline. Quick confirm and next steps:

1) Intake submitted: Monica confirmed procurement fields captured; I've uploaded the ACE form to our shared drive and submitted the initial intake to AWS.
2) PDM readiness call: Hannah to lead on 5/18 at 11:00 PT (calendar invite sent).
3) Co-sell assets: Ben will share a condensed asset pack (pricing bands, security one-pager, datasheet) after the 5/18 call to support procurement.

Ben — please prioritize the asset pack and include a short note on discounting guardrails for marketplace pricing.

Alex — forwarding the intake submission confirmation from AWS below for your records.

On Thu, May 13, 2027 at 10:05 AM AWS ACE <ace-notifications@amazon.com> wrote:
> Hello,
> 
> We've received an ACE intake submission for Redwood Inference / Apollo Energy. Intake ID: ACE-44721. Our team will review and reach out with any follow-ups.
> 
> Regards,
> AWS ACE Operations

I'll keep you posted if AWS needs additional artifacts. Looking forward to the 5/18 call and moving the co-sell forward.

Diego
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
